Measured rectangles are x,y,w,h: chromium: root=(0,0,180,120), a=(137,0,130,20), b=(0,0,130,20); firefox: root=(0,0,180,120), a=(137,0,130,20), b=(0,0,130,20); webkit: root=(0,0,180,120), a=(50,0,130,20), b=(-87,0,130,20); Zenit: root=(0,0,180,120), a=(50,0,130,20), b=(-87,0,130,20). https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/11937 and the 2026-01-30 change https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/commit/0400daae18e8b47744240d6b3fc71b3c54689854. Only one engine agrees with Zenit, so no known_engine_deviation qualifies.
